title: Exponential generating functions for Apostol-Dedekind and related sums
summary: One of the primary objectives of this paper is to construct generating functions for Apostol-Dedekind sums. These exponential generating functions greatly facilitate the discovery of new formulas and relations involving these sums. Other primary objectives of this paper are to define Apostol-Dedekind sums of higher-order and other certain family of finite sums, and to construct their generating functions.
